title: "hey." not "hey you"
old_caption: Last week it was "hey you". Today it was "hey." with a period. Aquarius ran a full lab analysis. They were typing on the bus. Who notices every missing word?

title: A 4-second voice note
old_caption: A four-second voice note sat unplayed for two hours while Capricorn predicted a breakup, a song and a sneeze. It said goodnight. Do you play voice notes right away?

title: They smiled at the waiter
old_caption: Pisces caught the date smiling at the waiter, then at a dog, their coffee and a plant. Then at Pisces, the biggest one of all. Some people just smile. Lucky you.

title: Meme in the group chat
old_caption: Aries sent a meme and the group chat went silent for four whole minutes. Everyone was too busy crying laughing to type. Who in your chat reacts last but loudest?

title: "Rain check?"
old_caption: "Rain check?" and Libra forecast a lifetime of grey Fridays and one very long couch era. Then: Thursday instead? A rain check can just mean later. Who else spirals at plans changing?

title: Their friend followed me
old_caption: Their best friend followed Gemini, so naturally a corkboard and red string came out. Meanwhile, on the couch: they're SO nice. What does a friend-follow mean to you?

title: Who texts first?
old_caption: Wait three hours, three days or three years? Scorpio ran every strategy, then both phones buzzed in the same second. Jinx. Are you a text-first person or a wait-it-out person?

title: "We should hang out sometime" (full simulation)
old_caption: "We should hang out sometime" got the full treatment: a dictionary scan, six meanings, one overheating brain. Then Aquarius just asked when. What does "sometime" mean when you say it?

title: They sent "k" (full simulation)
old_caption: One letter. Taurus checked the archive, ran four theories and polled the group chat. Then a phone call cleared it up: "k" meant ok. Which sign would survive a single k?

title: The new profile photo (full simulation)
old_caption: Leo zoomed in on a new profile photo: the café, the hoodie, the smile. Twelve counter-selfies later, the truth came out. It was about the dog. Who checks every profile update?
